description: Registry of content sources evaluated for Adaptive Study English learning repository with intellectual property and licensing classification.

sources.name: Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD 2.0)
sources.rationale: High quality reading passages sourced from Wikipedia on academic, science, history, and geographical topics with human-generated comprehension questions, exact answer spans, and multi-annotator consensus.

sources.name: Simple English Wikipedia
sources.rationale: Articles specifically written in clear, graded English vocabulary for language learners, ideal for CEFR A2-B1-B2 academic reading comprehension on general IELTS topics (climate, technology, culture).

sources.name: Wikibooks: English Grammar & English Grammar Worksheets
sources.rationale: Open educational textbook chapters providing explicit grammar rule explanations, illustrative example sentences, and fill-in-the-blank / sentence transformation exercises with verified grammar keys.

sources.name: Wikibooks: Rhetoric and Composition & Saylor OER
sources.rationale: Open-access curriculum covering academic writing modes (argumentative, expository, cause-and-effect, descriptive analysis) directly matching IELTS Academic Task 1 and Task 2 structures.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons Spoken Wikipedia Project
sources.rationale: High quality spoken audio files recorded by native English speakers with exact matching Wikipedia revisions as verbatim transcripts, allowing legitimate listening comprehension exercises without copyright violation.

sources.name: Free Dictionary API (English Wiktionary)
sources.rationale: Structured open REST API providing IPA phonetics, part of speech breakdown, multiple senses/definitions, contextual example sentences, and direct Wikimedia Commons pronunciation audio links.

sources.name: Official English Wiktionary REST API
sources.rationale: High-availability Wikimedia Foundation official endpoint providing comprehensive multi-sense lexical definitions, etymologies, and usage examples under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike.

sources.name: Public Speaking & Communication OER Collection
sources.rationale: Open educational speech topics, communicative tasks, impromptu prompts, and speaking evaluation rubrics inspired by structured spoken communication.

sources.name: Council of Europe CEFR Companion Volume
sources.license: Reference Only / Council of Europe Copyright
sources.rationale: Used strictly as a standard reference for proficiency band descriptors (A1 to C2) and syllabus level mapping. No direct textual duplication or scraping permitted.

sources.name: IELTS Public Band Descriptors
sources.license: Reference Only / British Council, IDP, Cambridge
sources.rationale: Used strictly as conceptual reference for writing and speaking assessment dimensions (Task Achievement, Coherence & Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range & Accuracy). No test materials may be copied.

sources.name: Averil Coxhead Academic Word List (AWL) Sublists
sources.rationale: Used strictly as a list of lemmas/headwords for curriculum targeting in vocabulary crawling. Lexical definitions are retrieved exclusively from open dictionary APIs.

sources.name: British Council LearnEnglish
sources.rationale: Commercial copyright. Content is strictly proprietary; automated scraping and republication without a commercial license is prohibited.

sources.name: Cambridge University Press Assessment & Dictionaries
sources.rationale: Strict proprietary terms of service prohibiting automated data extraction, bot scraping, and redistributing dictionary or exam prep content.

sources.name: Official IELTS Past Papers & Audio Recordings
sources.rationale: Actual IELTS test papers, listening audio tracks, and test passages are proprietary intellectual property. Unlicensed distribution is illegal.

sources.name: Commercial IELTS Preparation Blogs (IELTS Liz, IELTS Advantage, etc.)
sources.rationale: Proprietary personal and commercial educational content. Free to read online does not permit automated collection or commercial product reuse.

sources.name: Google Search SERP Scraping
sources.rationale: Scraping search engine results is strictly prohibited by Google Terms of Service and violates project specifications.

sources.name: Chương trình GDPT 2018 - Tiếng Anh 6-9 Global Success (NXB Giáo Dục Việt Nam & Pearson)
sources.rationale: Official Vietnamese secondary education English curriculum blueprint. Used to calibrate skills, learning objectives, vocabulary collocations, phonetics, grammar drills, and standardized midterm/final examinations.

sources.name: SGK Tiếng Anh 6 Tập 1 - Global Success (NXB Giáo Dục Việt Nam & Pearson)
sources.rationale: Sách giáo khoa Tiếng Anh 6 Tập 1 chính thống theo Chương trình GDPT 2018. Khai thác bài tập Unit 2 (My House), bài đọc Crazy House Hotel, bài nghe ngôi nhà của Mai, ngữ pháp sở hữu cách và giới từ chỉ vị trí.

sources.name: SGK Tiếng Anh 6 Tập 2 - Global Success (NXB Giáo Dục Việt Nam & Pearson)
sources.rationale: Sách giáo khoa Tiếng Anh 6 Tập 2 chính thống theo Chương trình GDPT 2018. Khai thác bài tập Unit 7 (Television), lịch phát sóng TV guide, các kênh truyền hình, từ để hỏi Wh-questions, và liên từ câu ghép (and, but, so).
